subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between K and J when counted from the right of K. Only three people sit between D and B when counted from the right of B. J sits to the immediate right of B. A sits to the immediate right of L.

Who sits fourth to the right of C?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

 
• Only two people sit between K and J when counted from the right of K.
 
• Only three people sit between D and B when counted from the right of B.
 
• J sits to the immediate right of B.
 
• A sits to the immediate right of L.

The final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a2ef77ca835ca502eeaf116fdc983b1230e68d03ffe2ebeca6b3b855ca74a15.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
